reviews.text: 最期待的VR游戏之一 没有让我失望 当时预告的时候感觉机甲风格酷似阿凡达里的那些。 打起来确实得劲 就是一拳砸在墙上手有点痛QAQ
奶奶滴，第四天死活打不过，全尼玛蓝色蓄力护甲狗，强度是不是有点高了，主要是pico4VD串流高强度挥拳有时候跟不上会掉帧，而且大猩猩移动方式不那么习惯，一个手移动，一个手挥拳，还要移动视角对着敌人，玩一个小时就大汗淋漓

非常爽快的VR机甲竞技场游戏，玩家挥拳带动大机甲挥拳，打击感非常棒，也非常解压。 移动方式比较特殊需要一点点时间适应，按住扳机挥动手臂，机甲会向挥动的反方向移动，双手撑地移动能够撞飞敌人。 游戏在打完一场战斗后会有3次行动机会，从随机的两个行动选项中二选一，可选项有修理、商店、随机事件等等。 前两章有5场战斗，最后一场战斗最后是关底boss。最后一章则是一个线性关卡，途中会有两次修理（回血）。 对杂鱼推荐试试爪子，能够抓住敌人后丢出去，配合丢出的敌人会吸引其它敌人攻击的插件可以在旁边看戏。 boss战只要会打一下就跑几乎没有难度。地上灵活的狗.jpg。 #由于运动比较激烈请注意保持足够的空间，不然一拳打爆的就不只是机器狗了。 and，we need chinese！

Wish I could return the game but too late now. Really enjoyed the different weapons, upgrades and synergies until I finished the second boss. All of a sudden all of that stuff dissapears as you're mowing through basic enemies for way too long, while the only thing you can do with your hard-earned winnings is repair your mech. At the end, only to end up with 3 very bullet-spongey "walks straight at you and hits you with the same attack" bosses. This is where I quit the game cause I was not having fun. It's weird that the whole tower segment and it's boss takes away all of the things that made this game feel unique and polished, and kinda gives you that typical "VR-game thats actually a tech demo" feel. Don't feel like replaying if I have to go through that again every playthrough.

The game is very fun, you can easily get lost for hours punching robot dogs, I wont go into depth on how cool the game is because theres thousands of other reviewers talking about that. The one big flaw with this game is that it is perma-death. For some reason, they decided to make it so the game is perma-death. So if you die, you will have to restart to the very beginning of the campaign. Which shouldnt be an issue right? There are mechanics that can help you repair your mech after each fight. Well no, see theres a limited ammount of repairs you can have so sometimes if your mech is badded up to the brink of death and you have like 7 repairs that heal you by 10 HP then you will be ROYALLY ♥♥♥♥♥♥. Sometimes, the game doesnt even spawn mechanics so you bassiacly just have to give up before entering a fight, and theres a limited ammount of moves that you can do until the fight so you cannot just WAIT for a mechanic to spawn so by the time your at the fight you simply have to accept death because there is literally nothing you can do. Moral of the story: Fun game, shouldnt be perma-death. Would love to play it with a checkpoint system or a easy mode.

If I could give a side thumb review I would. There is genuinely something great here; but there is a lot that is not. Starting with the positives: the atmosphere and 'cutscene style' to put it are incredible. Absolute treat seeing the interactions and responses from characters when they are speaking. The combat can feel awesome at times, but ultimately falls flat a lot of the time. Boss fights are fun and done pretty well, I wish we had more of these. Rogue lite elements are a bit rough, but is fairly fun to partake in. While its a short experience all in all, its a complete one and unfortunately this is something to be cherished in VR gaming in general. Negatives: The best or at least, easiest weapons to use well are smashing-type weapons. There is a reason for this, and its because if you're not wildly swinging all the time you will take tons of damage. due to enemies staggering their attacks constantly, so to best counter this you need to constantly be hitting every enemy all the time to counter their attack pattern and stay in control. If you try to be fancy by using other types of weapons, you just get punished for it(for example, grabbers, harpoons, chainsaw blade); or they're just terrible during bossfights which make them worthless. Your arms will get caught on other enemies(not talking about the 'stuck' mechanic at all here), terrain, random car/debris in the fight zone, your other arm all the time, making you take a ton of damage you don't deserve to take. Taking damage is extremely bad and its very frustrating to take damage from no fault of your own. Alpha dogs suck. This is probably a skill issue, but if you do what King tells you to do (hit them on the back of the head!) sometimes you still get grabbed anyway. If you hit an alpha dog when its completed its 'attack run' and has visibly 'charged down' you probably will still get grabbed anyway. I don't know what the game wants me to do with them, but holy crap are these guys just a chore to fight. I often find myself running across the field wildly to wait for their obnoxiously long attack run to end, only to have to run from a 2nd alpha dog that is also present in order to slowly whittle them down. Making them a bit more consistent and have better messaging on what you should be doing would be awesome here. Repairing: Having bad RNG and not being able to repair is extremely frustrating. You can be at deaths door and then not even get a healing merchant offered to you; this is a big headscratcher. WHY? When you do get given a repair merchant, its often Chile who will sometimes destroy your rilla instead based off of RNG. RNG on top of RNG, nice. You might say, maybe use a repair kit, but you shouldn't because you need to save them for before the Underdome run... The underdome run is really odd and doesn't play well considering the Gorillas extremely airy movement style. I applaud them for trying to change it up before the finale, but this one did not hit the mark for me. Not being given an opportunity to heal before you start from a merchant is a very odd choice, and the extra expensive repairs during the event itself also feel very bad. Enemy variety is low and this hurts its ability to be a roguelite you want to return too often. All in all, I really wanted to say I just got a blast out of the game; I didn't. I often found I was having fun, but would get frustrated often from hits that didn't deserve to take, and being forced to play so defensively to try to avoid damage it ended up being tedious and not visceral. Despite my gripes, this is still an innovative game for VR that is not a tech demo; and for that the devs should be congratulated.

While quite the workout, the controls are a bit wonky. You just end up flailing around. The movement is grip pull/push based which I guess works but the issue is the same arms are used for combat. So you can't really move and hit at the same time. The Meta progression is non-existent as far I could tell. When you die, you start over again with the same equipment. Yawn. The runs just unlock better equipment and reputation that adjust game play as you go along. It would have been nice to skip ahead as I just got bored watching and listening to the same story line over and over. And the story, well, just didn't appeal to me. I didn't feel for the characters and their "mission". I couldn't relate to anyone and really didn't care. The desolate planet speech just grated on me. Maybe there is just one too many of these type of story lines. After "progressing" and dying X amount of times, I just couldn't bare to do another run. So, it goes on the trash heap of unfinished games.

No. Just, no. I was 3 hours in, too long to get a refund, when an arm starts doing 1/10th of the damage for no apparent reason and with no way to find out. There's no justification for treating words like they are a scarce resource. Explain your game and its calculations, preferably before decisions are irrevocably made by a player. EDIT: Further play reveals this is a bug that occurs after applying an upgrade to an arm. The dev's must have contempt for your cherished leisure time, or they are conservatives, because they deny you the option to ABORT a bad run and start over again. Instead you need to go through the entire day, initiate a fight, wait through a bootup sequence and other introductory yawns, and commit bot suicide. Slowly. Further, the risk of experimentation becomes unsustainable as you progress in the game because your "save" is anything but, and you are promptly whisked back to the beginning of the game if you die. So, think twice before trying a new weapon once you are several hours into your run. Add the physically demanding nature of the title which require breaks every few hours or so, and it's almost like the devs want you to find something better to do with your free time instead of beating your head against the same fights, bosses, etc over and over again with no advancement in the story. I am aware that Underdogs is attempting to be a certain genre, but it would lose nothing and gain a broader audience by simply offering the option of a persistent save. It's such a shame too, because this would be a 7+/10 game--a great game--but for these unforced errors in design. The writing and music (which isn't even a genre that I normally like) are remarkably good, efficient and completely lacking in pretension, and the art style is simple, pleasing, resembles the art made by Gorrilaz--I see what you did there--and is perfectly in tune with the other creative elements. The 3d assets are unremarkable but they get the job done. My only minor complaint about the artistic presentation is I never felt the scale of the mechs or the environments because, aside from a few unconvincing, low-poly cars, there are no person-sized assets at ground level. This is a minor complaint because the scale of the mechs is not integral to the experience. There is also a weird design decision where putting your real hands naturally into a low-ready position (sternum high) results in your mech hands (or the equivalent) being ground level. Further, the end of your mech's arms extends further out from your hands which, when added to the fact that that the mech's range of arm motion from retracted to extended does not seem to linearly mirror your own results in an avoidable learning curve and subtracts from the intended feeling of smashing enemies apart with your bare hands. The bottom line: I desperately want to like this game-but, devs, you're probably doing something wrong if frustration is the final word over enjoyment.

小而精品的VR游戏，玩的挺爽，但是身体吃不消，每天感觉1小时就是极限（有动力玩，但是没力气了）。 本作特点是高速战斗，玩家和怪的机动性都非常强，但是攻击都是有前摇和间隔。在1V多情况下，不仅需要频繁的转身和切换身位，还要保证攻击命中。 玩家在各类怪物中，割草、横冲直撞，通过VR视角直接带来，非常爽、不一样体验。同时各种武器是有蛮多操作和搭配，例如可以抓、锯跳越的狗子；直接锯子+斧子，强控BOSS；纯冲撞玩法，围着场地绕圈。 虽然瑕不掩瑜，但还是有问题： 常玩此类游戏，对于如何操作时心知肚明，但是“身体跟不上脑子”，导致非常消耗体能，加上肉鸽模式下，是非常需要暂停休息的功能或者回合。 肉鸽组合的限制太多，本来行动和金钱有限，却没办法自由选择行动方式，很难拿到想要的装备，还要投入钱去维修。例如：本轮第一次商店缺钱，而下一轮反而可以卖血换钱，再下一轮没有商店或者升级，就很头大。

Easily my favourite VR game (I've tried, enjoyed and disliked a lot of them at this point). Never thought a VR game would be in my top 5 of all time list but here we are, this game definitely went under my radar of VR titles but I'm glad I found it. -Game has awesome style, not my typical music style but fits the atmosphere and world to a tee and really makes you want to punch something -Challenging but rewarding Roguelike story progression forces you to play with different builds and makes you work with what you've got. -Everything is momentum based and damage scales with it -More than one way to scrap a dog: lots of variety in weapons and upgrades that lets basic and niche builds shine and adds to variety and replayability especially when playing the story mode (fav so far is using the nail gun to nail bots to the floor or to other parts of themselves, than using a grabbing hand to rip them apart). -Boss fights feel awesome. the first time you face one of the bosses feels like a real step up from usual horde of enemy types -Standing in your gorilla mech is incredibly immersive from a visual standpoint, combining that with the visceral sounds of impacts, saws and blades cutting through components and the arenas becoming littered with chunks of metal and parts of bots results in a 1 off VR experience/sensation in my opinion. -A satisfying movement system having you drag and slide the mech around the arena with your arms that adds locomotion as a way of dodging attacks and also slamming into your targets. -hugely under rated game, I'm yet to have naturally ran into any content to do with this game, if it wasn't for the steam sale suggestions id still be missing out on this gem of an experience that's like none other Played on Quest 3 using Virtual Desktop
